title: 3 Facts That Break Your Sense of Time

scenes.say: Three history facts that will break your sense of time.
One. Cleopatra lived closer to the Moon landing than to the building of the Great Pyramid.
scenes.sub: closer to the Moon than the pyramid

scenes.say: The pyramid was already about two thousand five hundred years old when she was born.
The Moon landing came only about two thousand years after her.
Two. Woolly mammoths were still alive when the pyramids were built.
scenes.sub: were alive in the age of the pyramids

scenes.say: The last herd survived on a remote Arctic island until about four thousand years ago.
Three. Oxford University is older than the Aztec Empire.
People were teaching at Oxford by 1096. The Aztec capital was founded in 1325.
